inbox_context: I run two crypto news/media sites for revenue: Coinography (coinography.com) and Memecoinist (memecoinist.com). Primary income is advertising and paid placements — banner ads, sponsored articles, newsletter sponsorships, press releases, and (for Memecoinist) paid memecoin/token listing & promo posts. CRITICAL: security and payment failures. IMPORTANT: anyone asking rates/pricing, how much to post/publish/advertise, media kit, sponsorship, listing fees, or ready to buy. NORMAL: vague collab intros that might become paid work. NOISE: cold RFQ/procurement spam, manufacturer outreach, SEO/guest-post link packages, newsletters, no-reply digests, fake partnership evaluations with no ad budget.

account_purposes.sales: sales@coinography.com — Coinography sales inbox. Goal: close paid ads/sponsorships on coinography.com (banners, sponsored content, newsletter sponsorship, social campaigns). IMPORTANT when someone asks pricing, rates, media kit, how much to advertise/post, or wants a package. NOISE: product manufacturers, procurement RFQs, SEO link sellers.
account_purposes.coinography: info@coinography.com — Coinography general/info inbox for the crypto news site. Same revenue model: paid advertising & sponsored posts. IMPORTANT: ad inquiries, rate questions, press-release buys, replies from advertisers. Also site/account/security issues. NOISE: cold RFQ spam, fake partnership blasts, newsletters.
account_purposes.memecoinist: sales@memecoinist.com — Memecoinist sales for memecoin news/promo site. Revenue from paid listings, sponsored memecoin articles, promo posts, and ads. IMPORTANT: listing requests, how much to get featured/posted, PR packages for meme coins/tokens. NOISE: unrelated RFQs, SEO spam, generic partnership templates.

p0.label: Critical
p0.description: Act now: security, payment failures, legal threats, VIP client emergencies.

p1.label: Important
p1.description: Revenue today: ad/listing buyers asking rates, pricing, media kit, sponsorship, or ready to pay to post on Coinography/Memecoinist.

p2.label: Normal
p2.description: Possibly useful later: soft intros, unclear collabs, follow-ups that are not clearly buying ads yet.

p3.label: Noise
p3.description: Non-revenue junk: cold RFQ/procurement, manufacturers, SEO link packages, newsletters, no-reply digests, fake partnership evaluations.
